## Data flow

This application uses a **hybrid Post-Redirect-Get (PRG) + Turbo** architecture built around [Hotwired Turbo](https://turbo.hotwired.dev/). Every mutating endpoint supports both paths simultaneously:

- **Non-Turbo path (PRG):** A standard browser form submission sends a POST request. On success the server issues a `303 See Other` redirect to a GET endpoint, which re-renders the full page with updated data. On error a full-page error template is returned.
- **Turbo path:** Turbo requests advertise `text/vnd.turbo-stream.html` in their `Accept` header. The same POST endpoint detects this via `fastapi_turbo.accepts_turbo_stream()` and instead returns a `200` `turbo-stream` body that Turbo applies in place — replacing a targeted element, appending a toast to `#toast-container`, or both. On error a toast stream is returned with the real HTTP status code.

The Turbo rollout keeps the existing POST route contract intact — dedicated `PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` routes may be introduced in a future iteration.

dot = Digraph()
dot.attr(rankdir='TB')
dot.attr('node', shape='box', style='rounded')

# Create client subgraph at top
with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_client') as client:
    client.attr(label='Client')
    client.attr(rank='topmost')
    client.node('A', 'User submits form', fillcolor='lightblue', style='rounded,filled')
    client.node('B', 'HTML/JS form validation', fillcolor='lightblue', style='rounded,filled')

# Create server subgraph below
with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_server') as server:
    server.attr(label='Server')
    server.node('C', 'FastAPI request validation in route signature', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('D', 'Business logic validation in route function body', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('E', 'Update database', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('F', 'Middleware error handler', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('G', 'Render error template', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('H', 'Redirect to GET endpoint', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('I', 'Fetch updated data', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')
    server.node('K', 'Re-render Jinja2 page template', fillcolor='lightgreen', style='rounded,filled')

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_client_post') as client_post:
    client_post.attr(label='Client')
    client_post.attr(rank='bottommost')
    client_post.node('J', 'Display rendered page', fillcolor='lightblue', style='rounded,filled')

# Add visible edges
dot.edge('A', 'B')
dot.edge('B', 'A')
dot.edge('B', 'C', label='POST Request to FastAPI endpoint')
dot.edge('C', 'D')
dot.edge('C', 'F', label='RequestValidationError')
dot.edge('D', 'E', label='Valid data')
dot.edge('D', 'F', label='Custom Validation Error')
dot.edge('E', 'H', label='Data updated')
dot.edge('H', 'I')
dot.edge('I', 'K')
dot.edge('K', 'J', label='Return HTML')
dot.edge('F', 'G')
dot.edge('G', 'J', label='Return HTML')

dot.render('static/data_flow_prg', format='png', cleanup=True)
```

### Turbo Streams path

dot.edge('F2', 'G2')
dot.edge('G2', 'K2', label='toast stream (real status code)')

dot.render('static/data_flow_turbo', format='png', cleanup=True)
```

![Turbo data flow diagram](static/data_flow_turbo.png)

The PRG path is preserved for all clients that do not request Turbo Streams (e.g. browsers with JavaScript disabled, automated tests that do not advertise `text/vnd.turbo-stream.html`). The Turbo path adds in-place partial updates and toast-stream error handling on top of the same POST endpoints, with no change to the route URLs or form field contracts.

### Form validation and error handling

| Scenario | Non-Turbo (PRG) | Turbo |
|---|---|---|
| `RequestValidationError` (missing/invalid field) | Full-page error template, `422` | Toast stream, `422` |
| Business logic error (`HTTPException`) | Full-page error template | Toast stream, `400`/`401`/`403`/`404` |
| Login failure (`CredentialsError`) | Full-page error template, `401` | Toast stream, `401` |
| Success | `303` redirect → GET → full page | `200` turbo-stream body, applied in place |

Toast partials are rendered from `templates/base/partials/toast_item.html` and appended to the persistent `#toast-container` div in `base.html` as a `turbo-stream` `append` action. The toast is styled by the custom stylesheet (`static/css/styles.css`); it auto-dismisses after its `data-auto-dismiss` delay and can also be dismissed manually (both handled in `static/js/ui.js`).

### Turbo request detection

All Turbo-aware endpoints call `fastapi_turbo.accepts_turbo_stream()`:

```python
from fastapi_turbo import accepts_turbo_stream, TurboStreamResponse, streams

if accepts_turbo_stream(request):
    return TurboStreamResponse(streams.replace(new_card_html, target="card-1"))
return RedirectResponse(url=..., status_code=status.HTTP_303_SEE_OTHER)
```

Turbo advertises `text/vnd.turbo-stream.html` in its `Accept` header. Detection is a capability flag rather than a preference negotiation: any request that explicitly lists the media type with a non-zero q-value is served a stream, even when `text/html` is ranked higher. Wildcard accepts (`Accept: */*`) and `;q=0` opt-outs keep those clients on the PRG path.
